out:
1. Dated stamp present — run `grep -L -E '((Date|Received|Filed|Stamp)[: ]*)?[0-9]{1,2}/[0-9]{1,2}/[0-9]{2,4}|[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}' BURN_*` to list BURN_* files lacking a detectable date/stamp; open each flagged file and read the header/footer to confirm whether a dated stamp is absent.
2. Dated stamp present — run `grep -Hn -E '([0-9]{1,2}/[0-9]{1,2}/[0-9]{2,4}|[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2})' BURN_*` and read each hit’s surrounding lines to confirm the date is a filing/receipt stamp, not an incidental date in the body.
3. Cited paths exist — run `grep -HnoE '(/.{1,80}|[A-Za-z]:\\\\[^ ]+|\\.\\.?/[^ ]+|[A-Za-z0-9_./-]+\\.(pdf|docx?|xlsx?|csv|txt|json|eml|msg|png|jpe?g))' BURN_*`, then for each hit read the citing sentence and test the resolved path with `[ -e "$path" ]` or `ls` to confirm it exists.
4. Cited paths exist — run `grep -HnE 'see (Exhibit|Attachment|Appendix|File|Doc)|attached|enclosed|filed under' BURN_*`, then read each hit and use `find . -name` or `ls` to confirm every referenced document/path exists and matches the named item.
5. Cited numbers appear in the named source — run `grep -HnoE '[0-9]{1,3}(,[0-9]{3})*(\\.[0-9]+)?%?|\\$[0-9,]+(\\.[0-9]{2})?' BURN_*` to extract numeric claims; for each hit, read the sentence to identify the named source and grep that source for the same number.
6. Cited numbers appear in the named source — run `grep -HnE '(per|according to|source:|see|Exhibit|Attachment|Appendix|p\\.? ?[0-9]+)' BURN_*`, then read the cited source at the named location and confirm the exact number/date/amount appears, not a rounded or different value.
7. No unevidenced superlatives — run `grep -HniE '\\b(best|worst|greatest|largest|smallest|highest|lowest|most|least|unprecedented|unique|only|first|never|always|all|none|every|no one|exclusive|unmatched|unparalleled|record-breaking|definitive|conclusive)\\b' BURN_*` and read each hit to check whether a citation or source in the same sentence or footnote supports it.
8. No unevidenced superlatives — run `grep -HniE '\\b(clearly|obviously|undeniably|indisputably|without (a )?doubt|proves?|conclusively|definitively|beyond (any|all) doubt)\\b' BURN_*` and for each hit read the surrounding paragraph and cited source to confirm the assertion is not an unsupported overclaim.
9. Receipt cross-references valid — run `grep -HnoE '(Receipt|Confirmation|Acknowledgment|Tracking|Docket|Rcpt)[ #:]*[A-Za-z0-9._/-]+' BURN_*` and for each cross-reference read the referenced BURN_* receipt/document or receipt log to confirm the identifier exists and matches.
10. Receipt cross-references valid — run `grep -HnE '(see|per|attached|enclosed|cross-reference|receipt no\\.?|confirmation no\\.?|tracking no\\.?|docket no\\.?)' BURN_*`, then read every cited receipt cross-reference against the source receipt to verify date, sender/recipient, and document identity match.
